reviewBody: I had a blast working with Splash Arts. It was incredibly nice meeting new people and working alongside new faces. Some of the art that the kids produced was outstanding and blew me away. My role was to encourage the young children and adults to display their artistic abilities, which was so fun to watch. Bringing art to kids has helped them work on their communication with other kids as well as improve their concentration on one task. These skills will definitely help later in their lives. I am extremely grateful to Bernie and David for allowing me to help out. It's been an absolute pleasure.
author: Mehreen
